title: 風雨歸村圖（1975.94）
title_orig: Returning to the Village in a Rainstorm
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1975.94）
medium: Handscroll; ink and light color on silk
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1530」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Returning to the Village in a Rainstorm
Handscroll; ink and light color on silk
Mr. and Mrs. William H. Marlatt Fund

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → ming；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Sirén, Osvald. A History of Later Chinese Painting. London: The Medici Society, 1938.（Mentioned and Reproduced: I, 91, 92, pl. 64, and II, Lists, 214）
Sirén, Osvald. Kinas Konst under Tre årtusenden. Stockholm: Natur och kultur, 1943.（Mentioned and Reproduced: pp. 519, 520, pl. 114）
Sirén, Osvald. Chinese Painting: Leading Masters and Principles. New York: Ronald Press, 1956.（Mentioned and Reproduced: IV, 58, and VI, pl. 195, and VII, Lists, 191）
Lawton, Mary S. Hsieh Shih-Chʻên: A Ming Dynasty Painter Reinterprets the Past. Chicago: The University, 1978.（cat. no. 3）

Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Reproduced: cat. no. 168, pp. 212–214）

dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。
款识原文未经本库目验；馆方亦未说明其对该款识真伪的判断。

colophons.text:
風雨歸村圖 嘉靖庚寅秋日樗仙謝時臣. [印] 謝時臣印

馆方英译：Artist's inscription, signature, and seal:  Returning to the Village in a Rainstorm.  On an autumn day, the gengyin year of the Jiajing era [1530].  Chuxian, Xie Shichen. 
[seal] Xie Shichen yin.
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。
